description: Use this when the user asks who has access to the account, what roles people have, who was invited, or how many seats are left. Returns members with role, scope, the sites shared with them and when they joined and were last active (on the website or through an AI agent), pending invitations with the role or sites each gives, and seats used and allowed. Owners and admins only. Not for who was alerted about an incident: use get_incident.

title: List the team
